name: Tachibana Shii
source:
Yokai Extermination House Gosanke, the head of the Tachibana family. A dual-sword wielder of a demonic sword, specializing in beautiful swordsmanship that looks like dancing. Because she is usually expressionless and rarely speaks, she doesn't seem to have anyone she can call a friend.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/ikiru-character?pgid=l3smunhx-ae310b46-59ef-4eb2-a392-13934165446a]official website[/url]]
